title: Late-Time Dynamics of Flow Matching: Distance Geometry and Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27653v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models transform simple random inputs into samples that resemble observed data. For a finite training set, a central question is how its geometry shapes the terminal dynamics and the probabilities assigned to individual samples. We address this question for flow matching with linear interpolation between independent Gaussian and empirical samples. The squared distance to the training set generates explicit paths contracting exponentially toward the nearest sample. We prove that exact trajectories restarted at prescribed late-time states approximate these paths uniformly over all elapsed times and compact sets of starting states away from Voronoi interfaces, with an error exponentially small in the inverse squared restart noise scale. translated_title: 流匹配的晚期动力学：距离几何与学习
translated_abstract: 生成模型将简单的随机输入转化为类似于观测数据的样本。对于有限训练集，一个核心问题是其几何结构如何塑造终端动力学以及分配给各个样本的概率。我们针对在独立高斯样本与经验样本之间进行线性插值的流匹配来研究这一问题。到训练集的平方距离生成了向最近样本指数收缩的显式路径。我们证明了在指定的晚期状态处重启的精确轨迹，在所有经过时间以及远离Voronoi界面的起始状态紧致集上一致地逼近这些路径，误差关于重启噪声尺度的平方倒数呈指数级小。界面附近的初始质量控制着精确分布与参考分布之间的二次Wasserstein误差。对于高斯重启分布和固定高斯管状重启分布，这给出了……的平方根速率（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文研究了流匹配的晚期动力学，证明在有限训练集上轨迹会以指数速度收缩至最近的训练样本，到训练集的平方距离生成显式收缩路径，并量化了由Voronoi界面附近初始质量所控制的精确分布与参考分布之间的Wasserstein误差。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in flow matching over a finite training set, late-time trajectories contract exponentially toward the nearest training sample, with the squared distance generating explicit contraction paths, and quantifies the Wasserstein error between the exact and reference laws as controlled by the initial mass near Voronoi interfaces.
